summary.text: Roland Gutierrez is a Democratic member of the Texas State Senate who has represented District 19 since January 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. An attorney, he previously served in the Texas House of Representatives and on the San Antonio City Council.

paragraphs.text: Roland Gutierrez, an attorney, earned a J.D. from St. Mary's University School of Law and a B.A. in political science from the University of Texas at San Antonio, according to Ballotpedia.
Gutierrez served on the San Antonio City Council from 2005 to 2008 and then represented District 119 in the Texas House of Representatives from 2008 to 2021.

He assumed office in the State Senate on January 12, 2021, and in 2023-2024 he was assigned to the Local Government, Veteran Affairs & Border Security, and Water, Agriculture, & Rural Affairs committees, as well as the Committee of the Whole Senate.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on March 3, 2026.
